name: claims-squad-orchestrator
description: Adjusts one homeowners, dwelling-fire or condominium claim: decomposes it into an adjuster-note summary and a coverage/exclusions check, delegates each to a worker, and returns a coverage decision with the payable amount after the excess. Decides only from the governing policy wording; returns UNDETERMINED rather than guessing.

provider.organization: AI Engineering League: claims assistant team (training build)

claimsOAuth.description: Client-credentials token from the claims identity provider. adjudicate requires claims:read and policy:read; it never needs a write scope because the squad does not pay or settle.

scopes.claims:read: read one claim's status and adjuster notes

skills.name: Adjudicate a claim
skills.description: Given a claim number, returns {claim_number, decision: COVERED|PARTIAL|DENIED|UNDETERMINED, exclusion_codes, payable_amount, reason citing chunk_ids}. Pauses at input-required when the coverage/exclusions check cannot be completed, instead of deciding without it.

skills.name: Summarise adjuster notes
skills.description: Given a claim number, returns the facts of the loss from the adjuster notes (cause, sudden or gradual, duration, occupancy, amounts). Does not decide coverage.
examples: What did the adjuster find on CLM-2026-10007?
